description: Live bookable room offers for one hotel and stay dates: total all-in price (AED), board (breakfast etc.), refundability and exact free-cancellation deadlines. For Goa, total_all_in counts GST, and any part the hotel collects at check-in is itemised separately (collected_by_hotel_at_checkin). The booking_url takes a human straight to this hotel on fostay.com to complete the booking.

children.description: Children's ages at check-in, e.g. [7, 9]. IMPORTANT for families: child-inclusive rates price kids' breakfast and extras upfront — always pass ages when children travel.

name: get_live_rates
title: Live room rates for a hotel
